article_title: Fashion brand Jaded has ad banned for 'glamourising smoking'

tasks.prompt: Why did the Advertising Standards Authority ban Jaded London's advert?
options: It showed a dress that was unavailable
It made smoking appear attractive and glamorous
It used a model without permission
It advertised cigarettes to shop owners
tasks.correct_answer: It made smoking appear attractive and glamorous
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה־ASA קבע שהדימוי המסוגנן והאופנתי קשר עישון לאורח חיים מושך ולכן האדיר אותו.

tasks.prompt: Where was the model shown standing in the disputed image?
options: By a scooter next to water
tasks.correct_answer: By a scooter next to water
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי תיאור המודעה, הדוגמנית עמדה ליד קטנוע ולצד גוף מים.

tasks.prompt: What object was the model holding in her left hand?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בתמונה נראה סיגר דק בידה השמאלית של הדוגמנית, עם אפר נראה בקצה.

tasks.prompt: What did Jaded London say it would do after the ruling?
options: Avoid smoking content in future adverts
tasks.correct_answer: Avoid smoking content in future adverts
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החברה התחייבה שלא להשתמש בעתיד בתוכן המציג דוגמנים מעשנים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “watchdog” refer to?
options: An organisation that monitors advertising rules
A photographer who created the advert
A customer who follows fashion trends
tasks.correct_answer: An organisation that monitors advertising rules
tasks.explanation_hebrew: watchdog הוא גוף פיקוח; כאן הכוונה לרשות תקני הפרסום, ASA.

tasks.prompt: What does “aspirational lifestyle” mean in the ruling?
options: A lifestyle presented as desirable and worth wanting
A lifestyle that is inexpensive and ordinary
tasks.correct_answer: A lifestyle presented as desirable and worth wanting
tasks.explanation_hebrew: aspirational מתאר אורח חיים שאנשים עשויים לשאוף אליו ולרצות לחקותו.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the words “stylised”, “appealing” and “glamourising” are connected in the ASA's reasoning. Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהתמונה עוצבה באופן מסוגנן ומושך, וכי החיבור בין האסתטיקה הזו לסיגריה הפך את העישון לזוהר או רצוי.
expected_points: Stylised describes the carefully designed visual presentation
Appealing means the model and scene looked attractive
Glamourising means this attractive presentation made smoking seem desirable

tasks.prompt: Why did the ASA consider the visible ash important even though no smoke was visible? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק שהאפר תמך בזיהוי החפץ כסיגריה דולקת והחליש את טענת החברה שלא ברור שמדובר בעישון.
expected_points: Visible ash suggested that the cigarette was lit
This supported the interpretation that the image depicted smoking
It weakened the company's argument that the object was unclear or unlit

tasks.prompt: Write a 70–100 word summary of the complaint, Jaded London's response, the ASA's decision and the required action.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את תמונת הדוגמנית עם הסיגריה, התלונה על האדרת עישון, הגנת החברה, פסיקת ה־ASA והאיסור להשתמש שוב במודעה בצורה זו.
expected_points: The email showed a fashionable model holding a cigarette beside a scooter and water
One complaint challenged whether the advert irresponsibly glamourised smoking
Jaded London said the cigarette was unclear and not the focus
The ASA upheld the complaint and ordered the advert not to appear again in that form

tasks.prompt: Do you think the cigarette can influence the message of the advert even if it is not the most prominent object? Use evidence from the article and write 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביע עמדה מנומקת ולהשתמש לפחות בשתי ראיות: הלבוש האופנתי, סצנת החופשה, הסיגריה/האפר או קביעת ה־ASA על אחריות חברתית.
expected_points: Refer to the fashionable model or aspirational holiday setting
Refer to the cigarette and the ASA's view that the association made smoking appealing
Explain how a background object can shape the overall message
